note: Candler County's zoning map is published only as a static JPG (May 6, 2024 adopted map) and a PDF (older proposed map). No ArcGIS REST, WFS or downloadable GIS layer of zoning districts was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web searches. The county's zoning appears only in the qPublic (Schneider) parcel viewer as a toggleable 'Metter Zoning' layer; no public REST endpoint for it was discoverable, and the viewer returned a bot-check (HTTP 403) to automated access. A county planning document says all unincorporated parcels are mapped AG-3. Metter and other cities in the county publish no separate zoning service found.
